about: JP-119. What laptop/check_jobs.py knows beyond the macbook-automations startup list (launchd/startup-manifest.txt). A job that is loaded or installed on the laptop must be on that list, or named here with a reason; anything else is reported as a stray. Josh 360's own jobs are not here: they are the entries in jobs.yaml, started by the one startup-list entry com.jgilpatrick.josh-360-jobs.

transitional.label: com.josh360.session-atlas
transitional.reason: Session Atlas is a long-running service that has to stay up, because the worktree removal guard fails closed when it cannot reach it. Until its definition is on the macbook-automations startup list, the job session-atlas-service installs it. That change to macbook-automations waits for the phase 1 close; docs/phase-1-close-checklist.md lists the two steps that move it and remove the installer.
